## What to implement

Add to `OctoPi.AI.Providers.Anthropic.Auth.OAuth`:

```elixir
@type login_callbacks :: %{
  on_auth: (auth_info :: map() -> :ok),
  on_prompt: (prompt :: String.t() -> :ok),
  on_manual_code_input: (() -> {:ok, String.t()} | {:error, :cancelled})
}

@spec login(login_callbacks()) ::
  {:ok, %{access: String.t(), refresh: String.t(), expires_in: pos_integer()}} |
  {:error, term()}
def login(callbacks)
```

### Flow
1. Generate PKCE `{code_verifier, code_challenge}` (SHA256, base64url)
2. Generate random `state` for CSRF protection
3. Start an HTTP callback server on port 53692 (or `PI_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST`)
4. Build authorization URL pointing to `https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize` with params: `client_id`, `response_type=code`, `redirect_uri`, `scope`, `state`, `code_challenge`, `code_challenge_method=S256`
5. Call `callbacks.on_auth.(%{url: auth_url})` so caller can open browser / display link
6. Wait for callback OR fall through to `callbacks.on_manual_code_input.()`
7. Verify state matches
8. POST code exchange to TOKEN_URL (same as refresh but with `grant_type: authorization_code`, `code`, `redirect_uri`, `code_verifier`)
9. Return credentials

### PKCE
Implement in `Auth.OAuth.PKCE` (or inline):
- `generate_verifier/0` — 32 random bytes, base64url encoded (no padding)
- `generate_challenge/1` — SHA256 of verifier, base64url encoded (no padding)

### Callback server
A simple Plug/Cowboy HTTP server accepting one request on `/callback?code=...&state=...`, or implement via `:gen_tcp` if Cowboy isn't available as a dep.

## Constants
- `AUTHORIZE_URL` = `"https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize"`
- `TOKEN_URL` = `"https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token"`
- `CALLBACK_PORT` = `53692`
- `REDIRECT_URI` = `"http://localhost:53692/callback"`
- `SCOPES` = `"org:create_api_key user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code user:mcp_servers user:file_upload"`
